sentences.text: Heard Shri Shailendra Singh, learned counsel for the applicant, Shri Mahendra Sinha, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the records.

2. The instant application has been filed seeking release of the applicant on bail in Case Crime No.37 of 2024 under Sections 419/420/467/468/471 I.P.C. registered at Police Station- Banthara, District- Lucknow.

3. The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of an F.I.R. lodged on 06.02.2024 stating that in an examination being held for taking selections for U.P. Police Radio Operators, co-accused Pradeep Kumar was appearing in place of the applicant.
4. In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.

entities.text: Ajeet Yadav vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. Deptt. Of Home
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that co-accused-Pradeep Kumar, who was caught appearing in the examination has already been granted bail by means of an order dated 16.04.2024 passed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.3680 of 2024.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Bail Application No.3680 of 2024
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: 6. Learned A.G.A. has vehemently opposed the bail application and he has submitted that involvement of the applicant in commission of the offence is established during investigation and a charge-sheet has been submitted on 14.07.2025.

7. Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that the applicant is a young man having no criminal history, he is languishing in jail since 07.07.2025 whereas the investigation stands concluded and the co-accused Pradeep Kumar has already been granted bail, I am of the view that the aforesaid facts are sufficient for making out a case for enlargement of the applicant on bail in the aforesaid crime.
8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

8. Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.
9. Let the applicant- Ajeet Yadav be released on bail in the aforementioned case on furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of Magistrate/Court concerned, subject to following conditions:-
